verdict.rationale: Bevy is a code-first Rust game engine and app framework built on ECS. It has no concept of user-built 'automations' that could be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back, so this workflow-automation axis is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Bevy ships such a capability. Any versioning of Bevy projects would come from the user's own source control, not from Bevy.
